summary.text: Jack Rader is a Republican state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 176 since December 1, 2014 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He owns and operates a resort business and previously served as a Jackson Township supervisor.

paragraphs.text: Jack Rader graduated from Pocono Mountain High School and earned a B.S. in business administration from Susquehanna University.
His professional experience includes owning and operating The Resort at Mountain Springs Lake and The Lodge at Mountain Springs Lake and serving as a Jackson Township Supervisor.
Rader took office in the state House in December 2014, and in the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Finance, Local Government, and Tourism and Recreational Development committees.
